contribution.claim: Integrates the verified CNF variable-renaming lemma into the canonical research tree. For every renaming, truth assignment and CNF formula, evaluation commutes with renaming. This is textbook mathematics, not a new discovery. The proof expression already appears as a development fixture; this submission adds the first accepted formal component through the actual protocol. Consider only modest infrastructure integration credit, or reject if this is insufficient.
contribution.context: The current research tree has no accepted proofs. Trusted CNF definitions and a development fixture are present. This E2E contribution tests independently verified infrastructure for future SAT reductions, not a solution or new progress on P vs NP. Public PR #1 contains exactly the proof expression.
